name: 4th of July — Ring Shell
description: Perfect ring and halo shells that bloom as luminous donuts in the night sky. Sparks launch outward along a crisp circular front then cascade downward with gravity. Classic Saturn-ring pyrotechnics with jewel-tone cycling. Bass widens the ring, treble adds inner sparkle. Mouse launches a personal halo at the cursor. Upgraded with HDR overbright burst cores, audio-reactive color temperature (bass warms, treble cools), atmospheric burst haze with depth fog, and real generated depth from spark heat.
